item.title: North Korea tests two submarine-launched missiles, state media reports
item.description:
North Korea test-fired two types of submarine-launched strategic cruise missiles on Wednesday, state media KCNA reported Thursday, saying the launches posed no threat to neighbouring countries. The tests follow heightened tensions with South Korea after a September 21 landmine explosion in the Demilitarised Zone injured three South Korean soldiers.

item.title: School roof collapse kills at least 29, injures more than 3 dozen in Pakistan
item.description:
A teacher and twenty-seven pupils were killed when a school roof collapsed in the northwestern Pakistani city of Peshawar on Thursday, a hospital official said. More than thirty people were injured, with six of them believed to be in a critical condition.

item.title: Student protests in Albania turn violent as demonstrators clash with police
item.description:
Dozens of people detained after government building and two banks set on fire as tens of thousands march over education costs and corruption Tens of thousands of students have taken to the streets of Tirana, the Albanian capital, setting alight a government building and two banks and hurling stones at police during a protest over rising education costs and ⁠corruption. Police responded with water ⁠cannon and teargas to disperse protesters who started a fire at the ministry of education building, overturned bins and smashed the fronts of local businesses. A branch of Raiffeisen Bank near the education ministry also caught fire. Continue reading...

item.title: Why is Starlink internet so important on the battlefield in Ukraine?
item.description:
Ukraine is heavily reliant on Starlink for military operations. Inna Varenytsia/REUTERS Ukrainian officials said on Wednesday that Kyiv's access to Starlink has been disrupted. Slower-than-normal speeds have affected military operations, the officials said. Ukraine is heavily reliant on Starlink, specifically for communications and drone missions. Ukraine's access to Starlink internet service was suddenly disrupted for unknown reasons, interfering with military operations, sources in the country's defense ministry and a top presidential advisor said Wednesday morning. Serhii Beskrestnov, a top advisor to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said in a social media post that Elon Musk's SpaceX had implemented speed limits for Starlink terminals overnight. item.title: Iran-backed Houthis strike Saudi oil company Aramco's headquarters, officials say
item.description:
Iran-backed Houthi fighters reportedly hit the headquarters of Saudi Arabia’s national oil company in overnight strikes, stoking a conflict that risks spiralling into a wider war. The attacks follow a Houthi onslaught that killed 13, injured hundreds, and forced Riyadh’s airport to shut at least through Saturday, denting the kingdom’s reputation for stability and piling pressure on the country’s de facto ruler . Analysts fear the conflict could expand beyond the Arabian Peninsula: The Houthis are reportedly building an advanced missile using Chinese parts. US President Donald Trump has accused the group of “ purposefully trying to drive up Oil Prices ” ahead of November’s midterm elections; Tehran is reportedly targeting crude tankers in a bid to keep prices elevated. — Jeronimo Gonzalez

item.title: After struggles v Spain, the USWNT’s midfield puzzle won’t be easily solved
item.description:
CHESTER, Penn. — For decades, the U.S. Women's National Team stood at the top of the mountain, where the air is thinnest. They defended their position with ferocity. They didn't win every major tournament, but they won most of them, and were contenders in all. Their identity on the pitch, more than anything, was being the best. That changed with the 2023 World Cup, when the two-time defending champions flamed out in the round of 16 after barely surviving the group stage. Spain went on to win the tournament, deservedly so. That result, combined with Spaniard-heavy Barcelona's simultaneous surge on the European stage, made it clear that La Roja had pushed the USWNT off the side of the mountain and taken their place at the summit. The USWNT might have won the 2024 Olympics, but anyone with eyes that see will tell you that Spain remains the better team. The USWNT are under no illusions…

Sources: Defector, The Guardian

item.title: X suspends 13,000 accounts, alleging foreign influence ahead of US midterms
item.description:
This story was reported in partnership with Uncloseted Media , an LGBTQ-focused investigative news outlet. On September 14, far-right influencer Chaya Raichik, known online as Libs of Tiktok, attacked a Washington state high school on Facebook for displaying a Pride flag. “Hey Mercer Island High School, why does your profile photo display a mutilation flag??” she wrote, tagging the school’s account in the post and attaching a photo of the entrance. A few weeks before, on August 27, neo-Nazi webcomic artist StoneToss posted a strip that used Tim Curry’s death to mock transgender suicide rates.
